description: This file contains asynchronous test cases for verifying the accuracy of spend tracking in a billing or usage system, focusing on different request patterns and their cumulative costs across various entities like organizations, teams, users, and API keys.

methods.name: create_organization(session, organization_alias: str)
methods.description: Helper function to create a new organization via an async POST request.

methods.name: create_team(session, org_id: str)
methods.description: Helper function to create a new team under an organization via an async POST request.

methods.name: create_user(session, org_id: str)
methods.description: Helper function to create a new user via an async POST request.

methods.name: generate_key(session, user_id: str, team_id: str)
methods.description: Helper function to generate an API key associated with a user and team.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key: str)
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous chat completion request to simulate API usage.

methods.name: get_spend_info(session, entity_type: str, entity_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches spend information for an entity (key, user, team, organization).

methods.name: test_basic_spend_accuracy()
methods.description: Test case to verify spend calculation over 12 requests at fixed cost, validating for key, user, team, and org.

methods.name: test_long_term_spend_accuracy_with_bursts()
methods.description: Test case to verify cumulative spend tracking over multiple request bursts.

ctags.name: generate_key
ctags.pattern: /^async def generate_key(session, user_id: str, team_id: str):$/

ctags.name: get_spend_info
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_spend_info(session, entity_type: str, entity_id: str):$/
